title: Unit Event — The Vivid Old Tale — Episode6 Cold Rain

meta.Event Outline: After successfully hosting their own event for the first time, Vivid BAD SQUAD is determined to ride that wave closer to the heights of RAD WEEKEND. As they're discussing that legendary event, the members start to want to know more about Nagi, the woman who played a central role.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I couldn't get a hold of anyone when I went home and called...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (So, maybe they forgot about our promise...)

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for not finding you sooner.
Your father and his team asked me to relay you a message.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Wait, they did?!
What'd they say?!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: Because of that, your father and his team are currently performing in our event...

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: As for your father's message, he said, “I'm sorry and I promise to spend the entire day with you next time...”

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy said that he'd definitely watch me practice on Sunday...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
And you guys are the worst...
You're always hogging Daddy and his team for yourselves...!

rows.Speaker: New Live House Hire
rows.Line: I'm so sorry, An... It's just...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Daddy... His team... Everyone around town... I hate all of you!!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Daddy cares more about everyone else than me...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I mean, he wouldn't break his promise with me if he didn't...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(And it's not just this one promise...
He's broken so many already...!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I was really, really looking forward to today after waiting for a whole week!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
I don't care anymore...!
Daddy clearly doesn't care that much about me...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: And I refuse to go home!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I don't care if they frantically comes looking for me!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Everything looks so bright and sparkly...!
They always tell me to go home before it gets too dark, so I never got to really see all this.)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Hehe. Running away was totally the right choice!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: That person isn't using their diaphragm at all...

rows.Speaker: Police Officer
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Are you lost, little girl?

rows.Speaker: Police Officer
rows.Line: Is your family somewhere close by? Can you tell me where your mommy and daddy are?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Um, so... I'm supposed to meet them over there...! Bye...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(What do I do?!
The police are gonna find me if I stick around the station...!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I have to look for a place where they won't!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Wait, it's raining...?! What do I do?!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, I can try the construction site...!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: They're constructing a really big building here! What's it gonna be?

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Oh, this sign might tell us.
Let's see... It says it's going to be for “Kamiyama High School.”

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
Really?! This is gonna be a school?!
It'd be kinda fun to go exploring♪

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: An, construction sites aren't exactly safe places, so don't get too close.

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (The police shouldn't be able to find me there and it has a roof over it.)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (But he broke his promise, so that means I also get to...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: Oh, I think I can squeeze through this gap...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Thank goodness! The lights are all off, but I don't see anyone else here so I should be able to stay here until morning...!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Hehe. Since I'm here, I think I'll do some exploring!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I can't see very well because it's so dark, but is this...? A classroom? Oh, there's a bunch of cords hanging on the walls! Is this where they're gonna put all the lights?

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: This is so cool! It's a school, but it's not done yet!

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: I thought I heard a noise just now...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Wh-What do I do?!
They'll kick me out if they find me...!)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Wh-What's going on...?
It definitely seems like someone else is here now...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I think those sounds were coming from the stairwell... I might take a quick peek...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(Huh? There's no one here...?
Same with that corridor...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Then, what were those footsteps just I heard...?)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(No, there's no way...!
Grown-ups tell us about ghosts and stuff just to scare us...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I can't see anyone, but I could've sworn that I heard footsteps... Which means...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?!
If it's a ghost... A-Am I gonna get eaten...?!)

rows.Speaker: Construction Worker
rows.Line:
Hm...?
I thought I heard a noise just now... Was it a cat?

rows.Speaker: Construction Worker
rows.Line:
Aha! There you are, phone!
Thank goodness I found you.

rows.Speaker: Construction Worker
rows.Line:
Alright, time to go home.
But I can still hear some footsteps echoing...

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line:
(What do I do...?
I wanna leave, but it's raining outside...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (And if I start wandering around, that ghost might find me and...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Daddy said he'd make his usual curry today...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (His curry's loaded with meat and really spicy, but also sweet because he uses apples to make it...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Mommy always asks for seconds and thirds, but Daddy's always prepared to serve more...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (Aunt Nagi and Uncle Taiga like to say how yummy and delicious it is too...)

rows.Speaker: Little An
rows.Line: (I wanna have curry with everyone, take a nice, warm bath and sleep in my bed...)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: I promise to watch you practice next Sunday around noon...
